title: Pennsylvania Faces Worst Measles Outbreak in Decades as Deaths Rise
subtitle: A fourth death linked to the virus highlights growing concerns over vaccination rates and public health policy.

summary.en: Pennsylvania has confirmed a fourth death related to a severe measles outbreak. The latest victim was an 18-year-old who suffered from a rare brain complication. This outbreak is the worst the state has seen in over thirty years. Experts are concerned because vaccination rates have dropped below the level needed to stop the disease. Meanwhile, federal health officials are facing criticism for spreading doubt about vaccine safety.
summary.zh: 賓夕法尼亞州證實出現第四起與嚴重麻疹疫情相關的死亡案例。最新受害者是一名患有罕見腦部併發症的十八歲青少年。此次疫情是該州三十多年來最嚴重的一次。專家對疫苗接種率降至防疫門檻以下感到擔憂。與此同時，聯邦衛生官員因散布對疫苗安全性的質疑而面臨批評。

paragraphs.en: Pennsylvania health officials confirmed this week that a fourth person has died from a measles-related illness. This tragic news comes as the state struggles with its most serious measles outbreak in more than thirty years. The latest victim was an 18-year-old from Mifflin County. According to the county coroner, the teenager died from a rare and severe condition called acute disseminated encephalomyelitis. This is a dangerous complication where the body’s immune system causes inflammation that damages the protective layers of nerve cells in the brain and spinal cord.
paragraphs.zh: 賓夕法尼亞州衛生官員本週證實，已有第四人死於麻疹相關疾病。這則悲劇性的消息傳出之際，該州正深陷三十多年來最嚴重的麻疹疫情。最新的一名受害者是來自米夫林郡（Mifflin County）的十八歲青少年。根據該郡驗屍官的說法，這名青少年死於一種罕見且嚴重的病症，稱為急性散播性腦脊髓炎。這是一種危險的併發症，患者的免疫系統會引發發炎反應，進而損害大腦與脊髓中神經細胞的保護層。

paragraphs.en: This death follows the recent passing of a 40-year-old woman in Jefferson County, which was confirmed just days earlier. Previously, the state reported the deaths of two infants in Lancaster County. According to the state health department, none of the four individuals had received the measles, mumps and rubella (MMR) vaccine. The infants were too young to be vaccinated under current medical guidelines, while the two adults were also unvaccinated. The MMR vaccine is highly effective, preventing 97% of measles cases, and it was responsible for keeping the disease under control for many years.
paragraphs.zh: 繼日前證實傑佛遜郡（Jefferson County）一名四十歲女性過世後，這起死亡案例隨之發生。此前，該州已通報兩名嬰兒在蘭開斯特郡（Lancaster County）死亡。根據州衛生廳的說法，這四名死者皆未接種麻疹、腮腺炎與德國麻疹（MMR）疫苗。嬰兒因年齡太小，未達現行醫療指引的接種標準，而兩名成人則未接種疫苗。MMR疫苗效力極高，可預防百分之九十七的麻疹病例，多年來正是靠此疫苗將疫情控制在一定範圍內。

paragraphs.en: Pennsylvania is currently reporting nearly 700 cases of the virus across 38 counties. Data from the state health department shows that about 100 of these cases were recorded in just the last seven days. With 133 people hospitalized so far, the situation remains serious. Dr. Debra Bogen, Pennsylvania’s secretary of health, expressed her sadness for the families affected. In a public statement, she noted that the state is working hard with local partners to stop the spread of the virus. She emphasized the importance of ensuring that the public has accurate information and access to the MMR vaccine.
paragraphs.zh: 賓夕法尼亞州目前在三十八個郡通報了近七百起病毒感染病例。州衛生廳的數據顯示，其中約一百起病例是在過去七天內記錄到的。目前已有一百三十三人住院治療，情況依然嚴峻。賓州衛生廳廳長黛布拉·波根（Debra Bogen）博士對受影響的家庭表達了哀悼。她在公開聲明中指出，該州正與地方合作夥伴密切配合，致力於遏止病毒傳播。她強調，確保大眾獲得正確資訊並能取得MMR疫苗至關重要。

paragraphs.en: Nationwide, the situation is also concerning. According to tracking from Johns Hopkins University, other states including Utah, Florida, Virginia, and Texas have reported dozens of cases. Across the United States, there have been more than 3,300 reported cases in 2026. However, experts believe the actual number of infections is likely higher than what is officially recorded. The United States had officially eliminated the spread of measles in 2000, but health experts now worry that the country may lose this status. International health officials are expected to meet in November to decide if the U.S. and Mexico can still be considered measles-free.
paragraphs.zh: 在全美範圍內，情況同樣令人擔憂。根據約翰霍普金斯大學（Johns Hopkins University）的追蹤數據，包括猶他州、佛羅里達州、維吉尼亞州與德克薩斯州在內的其他州，也已通報數十起病例。二〇二六年全美累計通報病例已超過三千三百起。然而，專家認為實際感染人數可能高於官方記錄。美國原已在二〇〇〇年正式消除麻疹傳播，但衛生專家現在擔心該國可能失去此地位。國際衛生官員預計將於十一月開會，決定美國與墨西哥是否仍能被視為麻疹消除地區。

paragraphs.en: Many public health experts point to a decline in vaccination rates as the primary cause of these outbreaks. To prevent the disease from spreading, at least 95% of the population needs to be vaccinated. In recent years, however, rates among kindergarten-aged children have fallen. Experts suggest that several factors are responsible for this decline, including difficulties in accessing healthcare, the use of parental waivers, and the spread of false information about vaccines.
paragraphs.zh: 許多公共衛生專家指出，疫苗接種率下降是導致這些疫情爆發的主因。為了防止疾病擴散，至少需要百分之九十五的人口接種疫苗。然而，近年來幼兒園年齡層兒童的接種率有所下降。專家認為，造成此現象的原因包括醫療資源取得困難、家長簽署豁免書，以及關於疫苗的錯誤資訊四處流傳。

paragraphs.en: There is also growing tension regarding federal leadership. According to The Guardian Health and MedPage Today, the current U.S. administration has changed how it reports measles deaths, which has led to a disagreement with the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). Because of these changes, the CDC does not include the four Pennsylvania deaths in its national count. Furthermore, critics argue that the administration has made the situation worse by spreading confusion. Robert F. Kennedy Jr., the U.S. health secretary, has frequently questioned the safety of vaccines and has reduced funding for local programs aimed at increasing vaccination rates.
paragraphs.zh: 聯邦政府的領導層也面臨日益緊張的局勢。根據《衛報》（The Guardian）健康版與《MedPage Today》報導，現任美國政府改變了麻疹死亡病例的通報方式，導致其與疾病管制暨預防中心（CDC）產生分歧。由於這些變動，疾病管制暨預防中心並未將賓州的四起死亡案例納入全國統計。此外，批評者認為政府散布混亂資訊，使情況惡化。美國衛生部長小羅伯特·甘迺迪（Robert F. Kennedy Jr.）經常質疑疫苗的安全性，並削減了旨在提高疫苗接種率的地方計畫經費。

paragraphs.en: As the outbreak continues to grow, health officials are urging the public to stay informed and seek medical advice regarding vaccination. For now, the focus remains on preventing further loss of life as the state works to bring the crisis under control. The recent deaths serve as a painful reminder of the dangers of a highly contagious disease that was once considered a thing of the past in the United States.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著疫情持續擴大，衛生官員呼籲大眾保持關注，並就疫苗接種事宜尋求醫療建議。目前，在該州努力控制危機的同時，重點仍放在防止更多生命逝去。近期發生的死亡案例是一個痛苦的提醒，讓人意識到這種曾經在美國被視為歷史名詞的高度傳染性疾病，其危險性依然存在。

keyTerms.definitionEn: A polite or formal way to refer to someone's death.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（經過），這裡作名詞指死亡。文中：This death follows the recent passing of a 40-year-old woman in Jefferson County, which was confirmed just days earlier.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To mention or show something as the reason for a situation.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這裡指專家提出某個因素作為問題的根源。文中：Many public health experts point to a decline in vaccination rates as the primary cause of these outbreaks.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To cause a situation or state to happen, often used in the phrase 'bring under control'.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 使（某情況）達到某種狀態。
keyTerms.noteZh: 這裡與 under control 連用，表示控制住局面。文中：For now, the focus remains on preventing further loss of life as the state works to bring the crisis under control.

quiz.question: What is the primary medical reason for the death of the 18-year-old victim mentioned in the article?

options.A: A lack of access to emergency healthcare services in Mifflin County.
options.B: A severe immune system reaction causing damage to the nervous system.
options.C: A failure of the MMR vaccine to protect the individual from measles.
options.D: A complication arising from being too young to receive standard vaccinations.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據第一段，該名18歲患者死於「急性瀰漫性腦脊髓炎」（acute disseminated encephalomyelitis），這是一種免疫系統引發的發炎反應，會損害大腦和脊髓的神經細胞保護層。選項 A 文中未提及；選項 C 錯誤，因為該患者並未接種疫苗；選項 D 錯誤，因為該患者已18歲，並非因為年齡太小而無法接種。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why might the official national measles death count be lower than the actual number of deaths occurring in Pennsylvania?

options.A: Because the CDC only counts deaths that occur in children under the age of five.
options.B: Because Pennsylvania health officials have refused to share their data with the CDC.
options.C: Because of a disagreement over reporting methods between the current administration and the CDC.
options.D: Because the deaths in Pennsylvania were caused by a different virus than the one tracked by the CDC.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第六段，美國政府改變了麻疹死亡案例的報告方式，導致與 CDC 產生分歧，因此 CDC 的全國數據並未納入這四起賓州的死亡案例。選項 A 與原文不符；選項 B 錯誤，因為文中提到的是行政機關與 CDC 的衝突，而非賓州拒絕提供數據；選項 D 錯誤，文中確認這些死亡皆與麻疹相關。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the author mean by the phrase 'a thing of the past'?

options.A: Something that is no longer considered a serious threat or concern.
options.B: A historical event that is being studied by medical researchers.
options.C: A disease that has been completely eradicated from the entire world.
options.D: An outdated medical practice that is no longer used by doctors.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。文中提到麻疹曾被認為是「a thing of the past」，意指該疾病在美國已受到控制，不再被視為嚴重的公共衛生威脅。選項 B 錯誤，因為這不是指歷史研究；選項 C 錯誤，文章僅提到美國曾消除麻疹傳播，而非全球根除；選項 D 錯誤，這是在描述疾病狀態，而非醫療手段。

quiz.question: Which of the following best summarizes the main message of the article?

options.A: The MMR vaccine is the only way to prevent measles, but it is too expensive for most families.
options.B: Pennsylvania is currently the only state in the U.S. struggling with a measles outbreak.
options.C: The U.S. administration is solely responsible for the current decline in national vaccination rates.
options.D: Rising measles outbreaks and declining vaccination rates are creating a serious public health crisis in the U.S.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。整篇文章探討了賓州及全美麻疹疫情的惡化、疫苗接種率下降的原因，以及相關的政治與公共衛生挑戰，總結了當前美國面臨的公衛危機。選項 A 原文未提及費用問題；選項 B 錯誤，文中提到猶他州、佛州等多州也有案例；選項 C 雖然提到政府政策，但文中也列舉了其他因素（如假資訊、取得醫療困難），故不應將責任歸咎於單一因素。
